alert_summary: A message from jane.tan@meridian-audit.com was intercepted by Mimecast due to an impersonation attempt using a high-risk Business Email Compromise (BEC) subject line. The alert is linked to a broader scanning campaign involving multiple instances.

investigation_timeline.output_summary: regex: 10 candidates, 5 validated; LLM: 3 candidates, 3 validated
draft-A: 4 action(s) selected; draft-B: experimental triage=true_positive

risk_assessment.rationale: The incident is classified as high severity because the email's content mimics common BEC tactics used to solicit sensitive information during 'audit' processes. Furthermore, the correlation of 25 scanning events indicates that this specific attempt is part of an active, large-scale phishing campaign rather than an isolated event.

recommended_actions: Block the source IP at the network perimeter
Escalate to the incident response / Tier 2 team
Correlate this indicator against the wider environment beyond this alert's time window
Escalate to a human analyst for manual review
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Perform a cross-tenant search to identify if other employees at victimcorp.com received emails from meridian-audit.com or the source IP 209.85.220.41.
Block the sender's IP (209.85.220.41) and the domain 'meridian-audit.com' at the corporate firewall and email gateway.
Conduct a hunt for any successful clicks or credential entries from internal hosts communicating with the identified infrastructure.
Analyze the 25 scanning events to determine if they targeted other specific domains or just victimcorp.com, which may indicate a broader reconnaissance phase.
Initiate a 'look-alike' domain search to see if variations of 'meridian-audit.com' are being registered for similar phishing campaigns.
triage_rationale_experimental: The combination of high-volume scanning behavior and a classic Business Email Compromise (BEC) lure strongly indicates an active, malicious phishing campaign targeting the organization.
uncertainty_notes: 5 enrichment lookup(s) errored or returned unknown verdicts; correlation follow-up/open-value search menu was not used
